items.title: John Handy Interview, 1963-11-21
items.q: Yeah, he's the first one that showed me how to finger saxophone.

ctx.x: You came back to New Orleans? Yeah. Which did you call her, here or on her lands? Both of them.

I got back to New Orleans and that's where I met George Gino. He was living about a block from me. He used to pass and he had me practicing on my clarinet. And he stopped there a couple of times and he went home and got his banjo. Him and I on the clarinet. And the clarinet began to die out. Everybody was getting saxophones. Everybody wanted a saxophone player. No clarinets. So I eventually got there a saxophone. And then George used to come by there and we used to sit down and figure out them chords and gather…
Pearson or something like that, huh?
